T: Future New York. Noodles by air.
D: A cab driver in future New York helps a mysterious woman save the universe.

S: Pan fried pork dumplings with a black vinegar and chili oil dip
Pork and cabbage dumplings pan-fried until the bottoms crisp, steamed under a lid, chilli oil and black vinegar dip.
Leeloo's sticky soy and honey drumsticks
she eats like she's never eaten before

Drumsticks marinated in soy, honey, garlic and ginger, roasted until sticky and lacquered, scattered with sesame seeds and spring onion. Mix 4 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tbsp honey, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 1 tsp sesame oil. Toss 8 chicken drumsticks in it and marinate 2 hours or overnight. Roast on a lined tray at 200C for 40 minutes, basting with the marinade twice, until sticky and cooked through. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds and 2 sliced spring onions.
Garlic and lime prawn skewers grilled, served on ice with sweet chili sauce
Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime on skewers, served on ice with a sweet chilli dip.
M: Wok fried pork, cabbage and carrot with udon in oyster and soy sauce
Thick wheat noodles stir-fried in a smoking wok with pork, cabbage, carrot, spring onion, soy, oyster sauce and a splash of Shaoxing.
fresh udon or thick wheat noodles@Deli
Diva's opera night chilli garlic crab
the Fhloston Paradise dinner during the Diva's song

Blue swimmer crabs steamed and cracked, tossed in a wok with garlic, chilli, butter and parsley, served with crusty bread for the juices. Clean 4 blue swimmer crabs, remove the top shells and cut each body in half. Steam for 8 minutes until orange. Melt 80g butter with 2 tbsp oil in a wok, add 6 sliced garlic cloves and 2 sliced red chillies and fry 1 minute. Add the crab, a splash of white wine and the juice of 1 lemon and toss 2 minutes until coated. Finish with chopped parsley and serve with a warm baguette and crackers for the claws.
W: Coconut milk jelly under blue flower jelly that turns purple with lemon
Butterfly pea flower tea sweetened and set with gelatine, a layer of coconut panna cotta beneath. Squeeze lemon on top and watch it turn purple.
K: Gin, dry vermouth and olive brine stirred and served with green olives

Ice-cold gin stirred with dry vermouth and a splash of olive brine, strained into frozen glasses with a skewer of three green olives. Put 4 martini glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Fill a jug with ice and add 240ml gin, 40ml dry vermouth and 30ml green olive brine. Stir for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the frozen glasses. Thread 3 green olives onto each of 4 cocktail picks and rest one in each glass.

s.note: Pan fried pork dumplings with a black vinegar and chili oil dip
s.how: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large non-stick pan and add 24 frozen pork dumplings flat side down. Fry 2 minutes until the bottoms are golden, add 120ml water, cover and steam 6 minutes until the water is gone. Fry 1 more minute to re-crisp. Mix 3 tbsp black vinegar with 1 tbsp chilli oil and sliced spring onion for dipping.

s.note: Garlic and lime prawn skewers grilled, served on ice with sweet chili sauce
s.how: Peel 16 king prawns, leaving the tails on, and toss with 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli, the zest and juice of 1 lime and 2 tbsp oil. Thread onto 8 skewers and grill 2 minutes a side until pink and charred. Serve on ice with 100ml sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges.

m.note: Wok fried pork, cabbage and carrot with udon in oyster and soy sauce
m.how: Slice 400g pork shoulder thin and toss with 1 tbsp soy sauce. Stir-fry in a smoking wok with 2 tbsp oil for 3 minutes. Add a quarter of a cabbage, shredded, and 1 carrot cut into matchsticks, stir-fry 2 minutes. Add 800g fresh udon, 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp soy sauce and 2 tbsp Shaoxing wine, toss until glossy and finish with sliced spring onion.

w.note: Coconut milk jelly under blue flower jelly that turns purple with lemon
w.how: Warm 300ml coconut milk with 60g caster sugar, add 2 softened gelatine leaves, pour into four glasses and chill 2 hours. Steep 2 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers in 300ml boiling water for 5 minutes, strain, stir in 40g sugar and 2 softened gelatine leaves, cool and pour over. Chill 3 hours. Squeeze lemon on top at the table and watch it turn purple.

d.note: Gin, dry vermouth and olive brine stirred and served with green olives
d.how: Put 4 martini glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Fill a jug with ice and add 240ml gin, 40ml dry vermouth and 30ml green olive brine. Stir for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the frozen glasses. Thread 3 green olives onto each of 4 cocktail picks and rest one in each glass.
